combo_label: In the Bathroom × Maps & Navigation × Vikings

entries.clue: Map upside down, signal gone, no idea which way is north
Sleek clinker-built raiding vessel that could beach on any shore
Looping line linking every point at one height
Viking-age memorial slab, its message spelled in angular staves
Ship's right-hand side, named for the steering oar Norse helmsmen hung there
Generations-long prose epic of feuds, farms and voyages
Rich white froth worked up from a humble bar
Facial thatch a raider might plait before going ashore
Bottled hair cleanser that stings when it runs south
Bubbly flotilla bobbing about your knees in the tub
Big book of the world that lived in the car's door pocket
Lightning strike on a rich abbey, over before help could come
